Firebolt 9 App   Actions   Specification                                     
                                                                                    
        Document status APPROVED                                                    
                                                                                    
        Author    Timothy Dibben                                                    
                                                                                    
           App Action JSON format                                                   
               Format of Action                                                     
           App Action Types                                                         
               Launch App (org.rdk.app.launch)                                      
               Send App Metrics (org.rdk.app.metrics.send)                          
               Send App WatchHistory (org.rdk.app.watchhistory.send)                
               Send DAB Request (org.rdk.dab.request)                               
               Set App API Token (org.rdk.app.apitoken.set)                         
               Set App Identifier (org.rdk.app.identifier.set)                      
       App Action JSON format                                                       
       All App Actions follow the following format                                  
       Format of Action                                                             
                                                                                    
        Part  Type Mandatory Description                     Allowed values         
       actionType string Yes A string specifying the implicit action type being requested to be performed org.rdk.app.launch
                                                            org.rdk.app.metrics.send
                                                                                    
                                                            org.rdk.app.watchhistory.send
                                                            org.rdk.dab.request     
                                                            org.rdk.app.apitoken.set
                                                            org.rdk.app.identifier.set
       actionData object No An optional object that contains data to be used by the Home App to fulfil the action See below
       actionContext string No An optional opaque string providing some context for use with reporting Any - max length 1000 chars
                                                                                    
                                                                                    
                                                                                    
       App Action Types                                                             
                                                                                    
       Launch App (org.rdk.app.launch)                                              
       This Action Type requests the Home App to launch an App                      
                                                                                    
       Format of actionData                                                         
                                                                                    
        Part Type Mandatory Description        Allowed values                       
       appId string yes The AppId of the app to launch Any                          
       intent object yes The intent to send to the App without the "context" object A valid intent object without the "context" object
                                                                                    
       Example

       Send App Metrics (org.rdk.app.metrics.send)                                  
       This Action Type requests the Home App to send an metrics to the back office for a particular app
       Format of actionData                                                         
        Part Type Mandatory Description                   Allowed values            
       appId string yes The App Id of the App associated with the Metrics Any       
       fireboltMeth string yes The Firebolt Metrics method Any Firebolt Metrics method name
       od                                                                           
       environment string no The type of environment the metrics originated from    
                                                           "prod"                   
                                                           "test"                   
                                                           "dev"                    
       timestamp integer yes The UTC time stamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch (January 1, 1970 midnight) when > 0
                       the event is generated.                                      
       payload object yes A payload object containing the Firebolt Metrics payload

       Send App WatchHistory (org.rdk.app.watchhistory.send)                        
       This Action Type requests the Home App to send a watch history from an App to the back office
       Format of actionData                                                         
        Part Type Mandatory Description                               Allowed values
       appId string yes The App Id of the App associated with the watched history Any
       entityId string yes The entity Id of the watched content.     Any            
       progress number no How much of the content has been watched (percentage as (0-0.999) for VOD, number of seconds for live) Any
                        minumum: 0                                                  
       completed boolean no Whether or not this viewing is considered “complete,” per the app’s definition thereof Any
       watchedOn string no Whether or not this viewing is considered “complete,” per the app’s definition thereof Any
       agePolicy string no An age policy of the user watching the content app:child 
                                                                     app:teen       
                                                                     app:adult      
                                                                                    
       Example                                                                      
                                                                                    
       {                                                                            
          "actionType": "org.rdk.app.watchhistory.send",                            
          "actionData": {                                                           
                 "appId": "iPlayer",                                                
                   "entityId": "abc1234xzy",                                        
                   "progress": 0.95,                                                
                   "completed": true,                                               
                   "watchedOn": "2026-06-23T18:25:43.511Z",                         
                   "agePolicy": "app:child"                                         
            }                                                                       
       }                                                                            
       Send DAB Request (org.rdk.dab.request)                                       
       This Action Type requests the Home App to process a DAB Request Operation    
       Format of actionData                                                         
                                                                                    
        Part   Type Mandatory Description      Allowed values                       
       topic  string yes  The DAB topic of the request Any                          
       correlationData string yes The DAB correlation data from the DAB Request Any 
                                                                                    
       payload object yes The DAB Request payload Any

Example                                                                      
                                                                                    
       {                                                                            
          "actionType": "org.rdk.dab.request",                                      
          "actionData": {                                                           
                   "topic": "applications/install",                                 
                   "correlationData": "abc123",                                     
                   "payload": {                                                     
                        "appId": "YouTube",                                         
                        "url": "http://192.168.2.108/app/youtube",                  
                        "format": "wgt"                                             
                 }                                                                  
          }                                                                         
       }                                                                            
       {                                                                            
          "actionType": "org.rdk.dab.request",                                      
          "actionData": {                                                           
                   "topic": "power-mode/set",                                       
                   "correlationData": "abc987",                                     
                   "payload": {                                                     
                        "powerMode": "Standby"                                      
                 }                                                                  
          }                                                                         
       }                                                                            
       Set App API Token (org.rdk.app.apitoken.set)                                 
       This Action Type requests the Home App to store the token provided by the initiator app for future API usage
       Format of actionData                                                         
        Part Type Mandatory Description Allowed values                              
       token string yes The token required for API calls Any                        
                                                                                    
       Example                                                                      
                                                                                    
       {                                                                            
          "actionType": "org.rdk.app.apitoken.set",                                 
          "actionData": {                                                           
            "token": "<token>"                                                      
          }                                                                         
       }                                                                            
       Set App Identifier (org.rdk.app.identifier.set)                              
                                                                                    
       This Action Type requests the Home App to store the apps own device identifier and internal version provided by the initiator app for undefined usage by
       the Home App (eg Store the Netflix ESN to display in the setting screen)     
       Format of actionData                                                         
                                                                                    
        Part Type Mandatory Description   Allowed values                            
       deviceId string no The device identifier as defined by the App Any           
       version string no The internal version of the App Any                        
                                                                                    
       Example
tables: The token required for API calls
The device identifier as defined by the App
The internal version of the App
